Who We Are
Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together . We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.
Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era.

From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.

Notion is looking for a Recruiting Program Manager to help design, build, and scale the systems and programs that power how we hire. This is a role for someone who moves fast, takes ownership, and doesn't wait to be told what to do — someone who operates with both strategic altitude and operational precision, and knows how to bring clarity and momentum to complex cross-functional work.
We're at an inflection point in how we think about recruiting at Notion, and this role sits at the center of it. You'll partner closely with Recruiters, Recruiting Operations, People Operations, and senior leadership to drive some of our highest-priority initiatives — building the programs and processes that define how Notion finds, evaluates, and brings in exceptional talent.
This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.
What You'll Achieve
The scope of this role will evolve with the team's highest priorities. Some examples of what you might work on:
Interviewer systems and efficacy — design the systems, structures, and standards that make Notion's interviewing reliably great: how we train interviewers, how we measure their effectiveness, how we calibrate quality over time, and how we continuously raise the bar; this includes programs like Interviewer 101, Hiring Manager Training, and functional interviewer certifications tailored to specific teams
Interviewer pool health — own the systems and strategy behind how we maintain a healthy, well-mapped interviewer pool, manage AI and experimental interview formats, and keep quality high at scale
Recruiting team onboarding and enablement — build and run programs that get new recruiters up to speed quickly and keep the team operating at a high level
Specialty hiring programs — provide program management support for specialized hiring motions like internal mobility, M&A integration, and other high-priority strategic initiatives
Cross-functional playbooks and infrastructure — build the processes, communications, and coordination frameworks that help Recruiting run with more consistency, clarity, and scale
Skills You'll Need to Bring
5+ years of relevant experience in program management, recruiting operations, or a highly cross-functional role in a fast-moving environment
High agency — you move fast, take ownership end-to-end, and don't wait for perfect information or explicit direction to get started. Ambiguity doesn't scare you.
Builder mentality — you're most energized when creating something new or improving something that doesn't yet work well
Strong AI skills — think beyond generative AI. We're looking for folks with hands-on experience building custom agents, skills, etc and have taught them to others. You're genuinely excited about using AI to change how a core business function works
Strong project management skills — you can lead complex initiatives from scoping through execution, managing stakeholders, timelines, and competing priorities along the way; you're equally comfortable driving short-term sprints and stewarding long-range programs that evolve over months or years
Proven ability to operate with discretion and high judgment on sensitive or high-profile work
Strong analytical instincts — you use data to evaluate program health, spot patterns, and make informed decisions
Outstanding written and verbal communication — you tailor your message to the audience and create clarity across all levels of the organization

Experience with recruiting program management workstreams through different stages of recruiting evolution
You use Notion and love it — you get what we're building
Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $140,000 - $195,000 per year.

A Note on AI
You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.
Equal Opportunity & Accommodations
We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic.

Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.

We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures.

The Workplace Operations Program Manager is responsible for leading and scaling programs that span the Workplace Operations organization. This role operates across functions and geographies, owning programs end-to-end while building the structure, processes, and tools that enable the broader team to operate consistently and at scale.

This is a cross-functional role that requires strong program management fundamentals, independent judgment, and the ability to influence stakeholders without direct authority. The ideal candidate is comfortable working in ambiguous environments, skilled at building clarity and alignment, and motivated by improving how teams operate and deliver for employees globally.

Own and manage a portfolio of cross-functional programs with global scope, driving delivery from inception through ongoing operation and continuous improvement
Develop and maintain program-level policies, processes, playbooks, and operating standards that enable the Workplace Ops team to deliver consistently across regions and functions
Lead cross-functional workstreams in partnership with teams across the organization, ensuring Workplace Ops priorities are clearly represented, aligned, and delivered
Identify gaps in current program offerings and proactively develop solutions, often without an established playbook
Build and scale operational tooling, workflows, and internal resources that improve team effectiveness and the consistency of the employee-facing experience
Develop measurement frameworks and synthesize data and feedback to assess program performance, identify improvement opportunities, and inform strategic decisions
Support the team’s internal operating model by contributing to goal-setting, roadmap development, and team ways of working
Manage vendor relationships and provide direction where relevant to program delivery, ensuring alignment to Airbnb standards
Serve as a thought partner to Workplace Ops leadership on organizational priorities, team capacity, and program strategy
Communicate effectively across all levels of the organization, translating complex operational topics into clear guidance and actionable recommendations

8-10+ years of experience in program management, workplace operations, or a closely related field
Demonstrated track record of independently owning and delivering multiple complex, cross-functional programs simultaneously
Experience managing programs with global reach, including stakeholder alignment across functions, regions, and seniority levels
Strong systems-thinking and process-design skills; ability to build structure and clarity in fast-moving, ambiguous environments

Proven ability to influence without direct authority across teams and organizational levels
Experience developing policies, playbooks, and operational tooling for distributed teams
Strong analytical skills; comfortable using data to measure program performance and drive decisions
Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to tailor messaging to diverse audiences
Proficiency with program and project management tools (e.g., Airtable, JIRA, or equivalent)
Familiarity with AI tools and emerging technologies that improve operational workflows, with an ability to identify practical applications that drive efficiency and better decision making across programs
Customer service orientation and a commitment to delivering a high-quality employee experience
Comfortable operating with autonomy in a high-visibility environment with senior stakeholders
This position needs to be based in the San Francisco office as required by the business needs for the role.

s.h: How We'll Take Care of You
s.t: Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.

Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.
A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates.

A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @ airbnb.com or @ ext.airbnb.com email addresses.

Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing. We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process.

We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

Project Manager – Large Projects Administrative Project Management Focus Position Summary The Project Manager – Large Projects is responsible for the administrative coordination, governance, documentation, tracking, and reporting required to support large, complex projects.

This role ensures that project information is organized, timelines are visible, actions are tracked, risks and issues are documented, and stakeholders have accurate information to support decision-making. This role does not own solution design, deployment strategy, customer adoption, operational readiness, or business execution.

Instead, the Project Manager provides the structure, cadence, documentation, and administrative discipline needed to keep large projects organized and transparent.

This is an individual contributor role that works closely with project sponsors, workstream owners, Solution Deployment Leaders, commercial teams, operations, finance, legal, quality, supply chain, digital, and other stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities: Project Administration and Coordination Maintain project plans, timelines, milestones, action trackers, decision logs, risk logs, issue logs, and dependency trackers. Coordinate project meetings, governance forums, steering committee reviews, and stakeholder update sessions.

Prepare meeting agendas, capture minutes, document decisions, and follow up on assigned actions. Ensure project documentation is complete, current, organized, and accessible to appropriate stakeholders. Support consistent use of project templates, tools, trackers, and reporting formats.

Governance Support Support project governance by maintaining meeting cadence, escalation records, approval documentation, and decision history. Track required approvals, sign-offs, stage gates, and governance checkpoints. Ensure project sponsors and workstream owners have accurate information for reviews and decisions.

Maintain visibility to open decisions, overdue actions, unresolved issues, and upcoming milestones. Help ensure governance processes are followed consistently across large projects. Timeline and Milestone Tracking Maintain the master project timeline based on input from workstream owners and accountable business leads.

Track progress against milestones, deliverables, and agreed due dates. Identify and flag timeline variances, overdue items, and dependency gaps for review by accountable owners. Consolidate updates from multiple workstreams into a single project view. Support visibility to critical path items without owning execution of the underlying work.

Reporting and Communication Support Prepare project status reports, dashboards, executive summaries, and stakeholder updates. Consolidate inputs from workstream owners, deployment leaders, finance, operations, commercial teams, and other functions.

Ensure project reports clearly reflect status, milestones, risks, issues, decisions needed, and next steps. Maintain accurate records of project communications and leadership updates. Support consistent and timely information flow across project stakeholders. Risk, Issue, and Action Tracking Maintain risk, issue, action, and dependency logs.

Document risk descriptions, issue status, owners, target dates, mitigation updates, and escalation history. Follow up with accountable owners to obtain updates and closure status. Flag overdue actions, unresolved issues, or missing information to project sponsors or designated leads.

Support escalation documentation but does not own resolution of technical, operational, commercial, or deployment issues. Budget and Resource Administration Track project budget information, purchase orders, invoices, resource assumptions, and financial updates as directed by finance or project sponsors.

Consolidate budget and resource inputs for project reporting. Maintain documentation related to project spend, approvals, forecasts, and financial decisions. Support administrative coordination of vendor documentation, contracts, statements of work, and related records.

Flag missing financial information, pending approvals, or budget variances for review by accountable owners. Documentation and Records Management Maintain organized project repositories, files, version control, and document naming standards.

Ensure key project documents, approvals, meeting records, reports, and governance materials are stored appropriately. Support audit readiness by maintaining clear records of decisions, approvals, risks, changes, and status updates. Capture lessons learned and archive project materials at project close.

Support continuous improvement of project administration tools, templates, and documentation practices. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in business, operations, project management, life sciences, engineering, or related field preferred.

Experience supporting large projects, complex initiatives, project management offices, commercial operations, business operations, or administrative project coordination. Strong skills in project documentation, meeting coordination, status reporting, action tracking, and records management.

Ability to consolidate information from multiple stakeholders into clear, accurate project updates. Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. Ability to manage multiple deadlines, documents, trackers, and reporting cycles. Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Proficiency with project management, collaboration, reporting, and productivity tools. Ability to work in a matrixed organization and follow up with stakeholders across functions and levels. Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting large customer, commercial, operational, supply chain, digital, or transformation projects.

Experience in life sciences, pharmaceutical, biopharma, healthcare, diagnostics, laboratory, manufacturing, or regulated environments. Familiarity with project governance, PMO practices, stage-gate processes, and executive reporting.

Experience with tools such as Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, Teams, Power BI, CRM, ERP, or similar platforms. Understanding of budget tracking, purchase order processes, vendor documentation, or contract administration. Project management certification or training preferred but not required.

Key Competencies Project administration Documentation management Meeting coordination Status reporting Timeline tracking Action-item follow-up Risk and issue logging Governance support Records management Attention to detail Stakeholder follow-up Tool and tracker discipline Scope and Impact The Project Manager – Large Projects is an individual contributor role focused on the administrative management of large, complex projects.

The role supports project transparency, governance discipline, documentation quality, leadership visibility, and timely follow-up. The role does not own solution deployment, customer adoption, operational readiness, business execution, technical solution design, or commercial strategy.

Accountability for those activities remains with designated business owners, Solution Deployment Leaders, Solution Architects, commercial leaders, and functional teams. Travel Requirements Limited travel may be required for project meetings, governance sessions, workshops, or site-based coordination.

Compensation and Benefits The salary range estimated for this position based in California is $112,500.00–$168,500.00. This position may also be eligible to receive a variable annual bonus based on company, team, and/or individual performance results in accordance with company policy.

The Enterprise Business Applications team is responsible for building scalable, integrated systems that power critical business operations across supply chain, finance, and customer enablement. We are looking for an experienced Staff/Senior Staff Supply Chain Program Manager to lead end-to-end ERP-driven transformation initiatives.
This role requires a strategic program leader who can operate across both business and technology, driving large-scale SAP implementations while ensuring alignment with enterprise goals. You will play a key role in modernizing supply chain processes and enabling data-driven, efficient operations.

In This Role, You Will...
Lead end-to-end supply chain transformation programs with a focus on SAP ERP implementations
Define program roadmap, milestones, dependencies, and success metrics across multiple workstreams
Drive execution across planning, logistics, order management, fulfillment systems and manufacturing
Partner with Engineering, Product, Finance, and Operations to deliver scalable, integrated solutions
Oversee system integrations across SAP and adjacent enterprise platforms
Ensure high-quality, on-time delivery in a fast-paced, evolving environment
Establish governance frameworks including status reporting, risk management, and escalation handling
Identify opportunities for automation, efficiency gains, and process optimization across supply chain operations
Drive adoption and change management across global stakeholders

15+ years of experience in Program Management with a strong focus on Supply Chain and ERP transformations
Proven track record of delivering end-to-end SAP ERP implementations
Strong understanding of supply chain processes (planning, procurement, manufacturing, logistics, order-to-cash)
Experience managing large, multi-phase programs with multiple concurrent workstreams
Strong technical acumen including system integrations, APIs, and enterprise architecture
Exceptional stakeholder management and communication skills across business and technical teams

Analytical Rigor: Use data to drive decisions: define success metrics up front, build reporting/dashboards to track project and post-launch performance, and use quantitative analysis to identify risk, scope creep, or underperformance early.

Process Improvement: Identify process gaps and inefficiencies across the project portfolio and drive continuous improvement in how the organization plans, prioritizes, and delivers work.

Risk Management: Proactively surface, document, and manage project risks and issues, escalating appropriately and driving mitigation plans to protect timelines and business outcomes.

Analytical Mindset: Comfortable working with data to define KPIs, build simple dashboards or reporting views, and use metrics (not just status colors) to tell the true story of a project's health. Dropbox is entering an exciting new chapter in how we support, retain, and grow our customers.
As part of our evolving go-to-market strategy, Customer Experience & Success (CXS) will assume ownership of commercial renewals, creating a unique opportunity to rethink how we drive customer retention and long-term recurring revenue. We're looking for an experienced strategy and operations leader to help shape Dropbox's retention strategy, modernize our renewal operating model, and build the capabilities that enable customers to realize ongoing value from Dropbox.
As the Renewals Strategy Principal Program Manager , you'll lead the strategy, operating model, and execution behind this transformation. You'll partner closely with Customer Success, Sales, Revenue Operations, Finance, Product, Legal, and Engineering to develop retention strategies, design scalable programs, and build the playbooks, operating rhythms, and automation that enable Customer Success to successfully own a significant renewal business.
This is a builder role for someone who thrives in ambiguity, enjoys designing scalable business capabilities, and is passionate about leveraging AI, automation, and data to improve customer retention and operational excellence. You'll identify new opportunities to reduce churn, increase customer engagement, simplify workflows, and drive measurable business outcomes while helping establish Customer Success as a world-class retention organization.
Over time, you'll help shape Dropbox's long-term customer lifecycle strategy, evolving our approach to customer retention across direct, channel, and self-serve motions.

Lead Dropbox's retention strategy for commercial customers, identifying opportunities to improve customer outcomes and recurring revenue.
Develop scalable retention programs, renewal strategies, and customer lifecycle initiatives that increase customer health, product adoption, and renewal rates.

Establish data-driven frameworks for renewal forecasting, customer health, retention analytics, and executive reporting.
Analyze customer behavior and renewal performance to identify trends, recommend strategic investments, and continuously improve retention outcomes.
Lead cross-functional initiatives that improve customer lifecycle management and drive long-term recurring revenue growth.
Influence senior leaders across the business to align on customer retention priorities and operational improvements.

Experience designing, building, or scaling renewal, retention, or recurring revenue programs within a B2B SaaS environment.

Experience building scalable operating models, processes, playbooks, governance, or customer programs that improved business performance.
Experience leading new initiatives or organizational transformations from concept through operational execution.

NPD Portfolio Data and Information Management
Provide portfolio management support by acquiring, analyzing, preparing, and reporting NPD project data, including scope, resources, cost/benefit, schedule, and execution performance.

Help NPD leaders make better, faster decisions by identifying, analyzing, and visualizing relevant portfolio and execution data.
Improve how project data and information are organized, maintained, and accessed across the NPD community.
Use AI and data management capabilities to make NPD information easier to find, easier to understand, and easier to act on.

Help expand practical use of AI within the NPD operating model, with a focus on improving productivity, reducing manual work, and increasing data accessibility.

Facilitate Quick and Easy Kaizens and help deploy standard work across the NPD community.
Evaluate and improve NPD processes for efficiency and effectiveness by analyzing workflows, identifying improvement opportunities, and recommending practical improvements.
Focus on process automation, standardization, and reducing waste within the NPD framework.

Ayoroa Simmons is one of the most trusted reality capture and BIM firms in the Eastern United States, with a client roster that includes some of the largest AEC organizations in the country and the U.S. Department of Defense. For over a decade, we have delivered surveying, laser scanning, Scan to BIM, and BIM/VDC services as a fully integrated offering, giving project teams the accurate existing-conditions data they need to design, build, and manage with confidence.
With a 35+ person team and a track record on complex institutional, healthcare, and infrastructure projects, we bring the scale and precision standards that this work demands. Ayoroa Simmons is an established firm at a growth inflection point, and we're building toward the clients who need us most.

Ayoroa Simmons is seeking a Senior BIM/VDC Project Manager to lead model-based coordination and digital delivery across complex AEC projects, while supporting client relationships, strategic pursuits, and firm growth. The ideal candidate brings technical credibility and client-facing leadership, managing BIM/VDC execution, advising project teams, and representing the firm in pursuits.
This is a fully remote role with some travel expected.

BIM/VDC project leadership
Align BIM/VDC scope, schedule, budget, and staffing with overall project goals.
Lead BIM/VDC execution from pursuit and preconstruction through construction and closeout, including BIM Execution Plans, model coordination strategies, and deliverable schedules.
Serve as primary BIM/VDC point of contact for owners, design teams, contractors, trade partners, and internal staff.
Establish QA/QC protocols for models, documentation, and coordination milestones; identify risks early and recommend mitigation strategies.
Support and guide Project Leads in running multidisciplinary coordination meetings, clash detection workflows, constructability reviews, and issue resolution, staying actively engaged while empowering Project Leads to own day-to-day meeting leadership.
Client relationships & pursuits
Build and maintain relationships with clients, contractors, design partners, and industry stakeholders; identify opportunities for new work, expanded services, and follow-on assignments.
Support go/no-go decisions, capture planning, proposal development, and win strategy for BIM/VDC-related opportunities.
Participate in client meetings, shortlist presentations, and pursuit strategy sessions; contribute technical content and value propositions.
Serve as a trusted advisor, translating client goals into BIM/VDC scopes, work plans, and deliverables.
Manage assigned consultants and trade partners, including coordination of their scope, project invoicing, and billing.
Represent Ayoroa Simmons at industry events and conferences; partner with principals and marketing to align VDC capabilities with firm growth.
Technology, standards & process improvement
Develop and maintain BIM/VDC standards, templates, workflows, and best practices across projects and offices.
Evaluate and select BIM/VDC software, including Autodesk, Bluebeam, and comparable platforms, to advance leading industry workflows and production.
Drive innovation in Revit and coordination workflows, extending the firm's established leadership in scanning and reality capture; implement automation, dashboards, and emerging technologies (4D scheduling, digital twins, reality capture, prefabrication).
Train and mentor project teams on coordination processes, tools, and digital delivery expectations.
Team leadership & mentorship
Supervise, mentor, and develop BIM/VDC coordinators, specialists, and modelers.
Provide technical guidance to project managers, discipline leads, and field teams.
Foster a collaborative, solutions-oriented environment; promote knowledge sharing across projects and markets.

Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Engineering, Construction Management, or related field; equivalent experience welcomed.
8+ years in BIM, VDC, construction technology, or digital project delivery, including 3+ years leading BIM/VDC on complex AEC projects.
Demonstrated experience supporting client relationships, pursuits, proposals, or presentations.
Advanced proficiency with Revit, Navisworks, Autodesk Forma, and similar platforms.
Experience developing BIM Execution Plans, clash detection workflows, and model standards.
Strong communication, facilitation, and presentation skills; ability to manage multiple projects and stakeholders.

Experience in healthcare, commercial, higher education, infrastructure, or mission-critical sectors.
Established client or industry network in the Eastern U.S. AEC market.
Experience with 4D/5D integration, digital twins, laser scanning, reality capture, or prefabrication workflows.
Familiarity with Power BI, automation, scripting, or model-based analytics.
Experience with project scheduling (Primavera P6 or Microsoft Project).
Professional certifications: CM-BIM, PMP, DBIA, LEED AP, or Autodesk certification.

Adoption of improved VDC workflows and development of BIM/VDC team members.

**About the Organization and the Project**
**Be Aware And Share (BAAS)** is an independent non-profit organization that supports people affected by forced displacement and oppressed communities and stands against fortress Europe. Founded in 2015 in Switzerland, BAAS is primarily engaging in working with and for people on the move in Europe.
Currently, the organization is mainly focusing on its Community Center in Ioannina, Greece where a variety of services are offered. BAAS also carries out awareness-raising activities in Switzerland. All BAAS work is financed exclusively by donations.
**Job Description**
We are seeking a dedicated Project Director who ensures the smooth and efficient running of our operation in Greece.
In this dynamic role, you'll oversee project implementation, manage human and financial resources, take the lead for strategic steering, handle logistics, establish and maintain a comprehensive risk management system and support the project team in delivering high-quality services to people on the move.
Your leadership will help BAAS navigate the complexities of solidarity work and drive our vision forward. You will be the key link between the operations in Greece and the organization in Switzerland, responsible for driving the Greek legal entity of BAAS and acting as its representative.
The Project Director reports to the Executive Board of Be Aware And Share.

* Guide the strategic development of the project in alignment with the organization-s goals
* Handle all tasks related to the Greek legal entity and act as its representative
* Manage and support project team promoting a positive work environment
* Ensure sustainable human resource management, incl. recruitment processes
* Establish and maintain effective monitoring and evaluation systems as per donor requirements
* Conduct regular risk assessments, implement mitigation strategies, and ensure the safety of operations for staff, participants, and the organization
* Ensure adherence to organizational policies and carry out regular policy reviews
* Assist in the preparation and management of the project budget, ensuring financial accountability and sustainability
* Act as Safeguarding Focal Point for incident management and compliance
* Build and maintain relationships with local and regional partners, stakeholders, and communities to enhance project effectiveness and outreach
* Manage all logistical aspects, including apartments, transportation and related resources

* Minimum 3 years of experience in operations management, preferably within the humanitarian or NGO sector
* Proven track record of managing projects effectively
* Strong understanding of logistics, budgeting, and compliance in non-profit operations
* Familiarity with data management and reporting systems
* Excellent leadership and team management abilities
* Ideally knowledge of Greek legal entities or experience with legal entities in other contexts
* Knowledge of project cycle management, including project identification, planning, implementation, monitoring, and evaluation
* Strong administrative and organisational skills, with the ability to work and manage autonomously, while also leading a team
* Ability and willingness to work in a dynamic and highly challenging environment, which may necessitate out-of-work hours
* Ability to work sensitively and effectively in diverse cultural contexts
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
* Demonstrated experience in building and maintaining networks with local and international partners
* Flexibility, especially with regard to working hours, areas of responsibility and contextual changes
* Excellent written and spoken communication and editing skills (English required, Greek desirable, French, Arabic, Farsi are assets)
* Drivers license category B, manual transmission and willingness to drive in Greece

* 1200 euro net per month
* 21 days annual leave (excl. Public holidays)
* Wide scope for independent work structure and participation in organizational development
* Access to diverse networks and partnerships
* Comprehensive training and introduction to the project and the organization
* The opportunity to take on a responsible position in a committed and dynamic team and to make a crucial contribution to the realization of the BAAS operations in Greece
**Application**
We look forward to receiving your application with a letter of motivation and CV in English by **10 September 2026** to **board@beawareandshare.ch** and **operations@beawareandshare.ch**.
We strive to create equal opportunities for employment and highly encourage applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of sex, race, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender reassignment, religion or belief, marital status, or maternity.
As a grassroots organization, and due to limitations imposed by local regulations, we are unfortunately unable to consider applications from candidates who do not have the right to work in Greece. This requirement applies to all applicants and is determined solely by applicable legal and regulatory requirements.
We particularly encourage applicants with lived experience of displacement and candidates from underprivileged backgrounds to apply.

You'll turn executive intent into workstreams, coordinate senior stakeholders across Sales, Customer Experience, Product, Marketing, Renewals, Professional Services, Data, and Enablement, and make the tactical calls that keep the portfolio honest.
This is a founding seat reporting to the CCO while the broader Programs function is built, and the reporting line may evolve as the team scales. In your first year, every CCO-level program will have a clear owner other than the CCO, leadership will trust your data-grounded view of program health, and the portfolio will deliver measurable business outcomes.

Own execution and business outcomes across CCO-level programs, including go-to-market transformation, renewal and retention motions, product feedback loops, and executive sponsorship for top accounts.
Turn CCO direction into workstreams with clear owners, dependencies, and timelines.
Coordinate senior stakeholders across Sales, Customer Experience, Product, Marketing, Renewals, Professional Services, Data, and Enablement, holding them accountable without direct authority.
Surface stalled work, unowned risks, and slipping timelines so the CCO has a reliable, real-time view of the portfolio.
Recommend scope changes, re-sequencing, or ending a program when it is not delivering value.
Drive follow-through from executive meetings by tracking decisions and action items to completion.
Track program health using data, connect execution to retention, expansion, adoption, and ARR outcomes, and communicate executive-ready narratives.
Build shared standards for tracking, reporting, and handoffs, and iterate plans with functional leaders based on field feedback.

Experience leading complex, cross-functional strategic programs at the executive level and turning ambiguous direction into delivered outcomes without a fully scoped brief.
Experience in Customer Experience, go-to-market, or revenue-facing functions such as Customer Success, Renewals, Sales, or Revenue Operations, with fluency in retention, expansion, and adoption motions and how they contribute to ARR.
The ability to influence senior stakeholders, including executives, and hold them accountable to commitments without formal authority.
Judgment to make high-stakes tactical recommendations under ambiguity, including when data supports changing direction or ending a program.
Data fluency to assess program health, diagnose where work is breaking down, and recommend a data-informed next step.
Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to move between an executive-ready narrative and execution-level detail.
Comfort operating without established infrastructure and helping build the function's operating model.
Reliable follow-through and the ability to navigate conflict and competing priorities across a broad stakeholder group.

You'll be the first Program Manager supporting CX Executive initiatives and the founding hire in a Programs function that will grow as the CCO's highest-priority cross-functional initiatives outgrow ad hoc ownership.

Documentation: Maintain internal databases of fiber/connectivity routes, including rigorous management of KMZ/KML files.
AutoCAD: Utilize AutoCAD to review, modify, and create site infrastructure and conduit design plans, ensuring accurate documentation of physical plant deployments.

Optical Networking: Strong grasp of DWDM technology, ILA requirements, and the technical lifecycle of MOFN deployments.
Commercial Acumen: Demonstrated success in negotiating complex fiber leases, IRUs, and construction contracts.
Relationship Management: Proven ability to influence stakeholders and external vendors to meet aggressive regional deployment timelines.

The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries.

It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for.

The New York Times is seeking a Program Manager to help lead and evolve the foundational technology that powers how work gets done across the company. Enterprise Technology is responsible for the core platforms, infrastructure, and tools that support our people and business operations — from HR and Finance to the newsroom and beyond. You will partner with leaders across Technology, Cybersecurity, and the business to create solutions that enable our mission of independent journalism.

Contribution to Deliverables: Identify areas on the project where it's possible to contribute more directly to outcomes. Some examples could include performing initial testing of new systems, drafting documentation, evaluating user requests during launch, or generating process flow diagrams.
Collaboration: Help develop relationships among the team and their stakeholders. Work with other departments outside of Enterprise Tech. Understand the differing needs of groups of stakeholders and advocate for them.
Escalation: Identification of risks and issues of understanding brought by others. Determine with the project team what parties need informing, develop mitigation plans, and track problems until complete resolution.
Continuous Improvement: Identify areas of opportunity for improvement, pain points, or other challenges within Enterprise Tech. Propose potential solutions. Following projects, perform closing ceremonies like retrospectives to highlight areas to improve on.
Analytics: Able to create project metrics that reflect the picture of status. Can derive milestones from a work breakdown and work with teams to provide estimates on completion.

SOCOTEC's Code & Planning department provides code compliance, permitting, and project management services that guide construction, filing, and municipal approval processes from initial planning through final sign-off.
